description: Twelve varied academic research requests used for repeatable end-to-end evaluation of planning, retrieval, validation, traceability, and bounded completion.

cases.topic: How are LLM planning agents evaluated in academic research?
cases.objective: Identify evaluation approaches, datasets, and reliability considerations for LLM-based planning agents.

cases.topic: How is multi-agent coordination evaluated in autonomous agent systems?
cases.objective: Identify coordination mechanisms, evaluation criteria, and representative academic evidence.

cases.topic: How are retrieval-augmented generation systems evaluated?
cases.objective: Compare evaluation approaches for retrieval quality, answer quality, factuality, and reliability.

cases.topic: What methods are used to detect hallucinations in large language models?
cases.objective: Identify major detection approaches, evaluation datasets, and reported limitations.

cases.topic: How is reinforcement learning used for robot navigation?
cases.objective: Identify common methods, evaluation environments, and reliability challenges in academic research.

cases.topic: How is federated learning evaluated for privacy and model utility?
cases.objective: Identify privacy measures, performance metrics, datasets, and trade-offs used in the literature.

cases.topic: How are graph neural networks evaluated in drug discovery research?
cases.objective: Identify representative tasks, datasets, metrics, and limitations.

cases.topic: How is algorithmic fairness evaluated in automated hiring systems?
cases.objective: Identify fairness measures, datasets or study designs, and reliability or bias concerns.

cases.topic: How is the reliability of tool-using LLM agents evaluated?
cases.objective: Identify benchmarks, failure modes, and evaluation methods for agents that call external tools.

cases.topic: How is memory evaluated in LLM-based intelligent agents?
cases.objective: Identify memory architectures, benchmark tasks, evaluation measures, and limitations.

cases.topic: How does memory improve intelligent agents?
cases.objective: Turn the broad question into searchable academic sub-questions and gather traceable evidence without assuming one agent architecture.

cases.topic: What makes an AI agent trustworthy?
cases.objective: Decompose trustworthiness into academically searchable dimensions and identify relevant evaluation evidence.
